title: CIA-UAP-003, The Central Intelligence Agency and Overhead Reconnaissance; The U-2 and OXCART Programs, 1954-1974
what_is_it: A CIA History Staff document chronicling the complete history of the U-2 and OXCART (A-12) high-altitude reconnaissance aircraft programs from 1954 to 1974.
interpretation_warnings: No body text was extractable from this PDF — all facts derive from metadata and the CSV description only.
A prior, more heavily redacted version existed, indicating sensitive content was withheld in earlier releases.

This is primarily a history of manned reconnaissance aircraft programs, not a UAP/UFO incident report; its inclusion in the PURSUE collection likely relates to U-2 flights being misidentified as UFOs during the 1950s–1960s.

key_facts.value: U-2 and OXCART (A-12) high-altitude reconnaissance aircraft

verifiable_claims.claim: The CIA developed and operated the U-2 and OXCART (A-12) high-altitude reconnaissance programs from 1954 to 1974.
